title: Small conversations, big meanings / Percakapan singkat, makna besar

rounds.prompt: What happened during the lecture?
options: He missed the location.
He found the pace too slow.
The explanation made no sense to him.
The lesson ran past its end.

cue.en: Track the meaning of lost in this classroom context.
cue.id: Perhatikan makna lost dalam konteks kelas.

explanation.en: He could not follow the lecture.
explanation.id: Ia tidak dapat mengikuti penjelasan dosen.

rounds.prompt: Which task comes before the phone call?
options: Buying admission passes.
Speaking to Jane.
Completing the sociology assignment.
Attending the music event.

cue.en: Listen for the action following as soon as.
cue.id: Dengarkan tindakan setelah as soon as.

explanation.en: The assignment is finished before he calls.
explanation.id: Tugas diselesaikan sebelum ia menelepon.

rounds.prompt: Why is lending the paper a problem?
options: Another reader has taken it.
She expects him to return it.
She is not its owner.
She needs to read it first.

cue.en: Listen for the reason following the apology.
cue.id: Dengarkan alasan setelah permintaan maaf.

explanation.en: She cannot offer someone else’s newspaper.
explanation.id: Ia tidak dapat meminjamkan koran milik orang lain.

rounds.prompt: How could the man help at the station?
options: By describing the bus schedule.
By recognizing the person being met.
By calling a lifelong friend.
By collecting someone he already picked up.

cue.en: Connect having met someone before with recognizing them.
cue.id: Hubungkan pernah bertemu dengan mengenali seseorang.

explanation.en: His earlier meeting may help him identify her.
explanation.id: Pertemuan sebelumnya dapat membantunya mengenali perempuan itu.

rounds.prompt: What has gone wrong at the restaurant?
options: The customer cannot explain the request.
The fish has not been cooked.
The server has brought the wrong dish.
The server wants the customer’s meal.

cue.en: Compare the dish rejected with the corrected order.
cue.id: Bandingkan hidangan yang ditolak dengan pesanan yang dibetulkan.

explanation.en: The server acknowledges an order mix-up.
explanation.id: Pelayan mengakui adanya kesalahan pesanan.

rounds.prompt: Why has he been absent from the student center?
options: He enrolled in additional lessons.
He is waiting there for a friend.
An illness stopped his writing.
An assignment has occupied his time.

cue.en: Distinguish the suggested reason from his actual explanation.
cue.id: Bedakan alasan dugaan dengan penjelasan sebenarnya.

explanation.en: His history assignment has kept him busy.
explanation.id: Tugas sejarah menyita waktunya.

rounds.prompt: How does he respond to the offer of a lift?
options: He offers to drive instead.
He asks to use her vehicle alone.
He proposes another route.
He offers a contribution toward fuel.

cue.en: Notice what the money is intended for.
cue.id: Perhatikan tujuan uang yang ditawarkan.

explanation.en: He wants to contribute to the travel cost.
explanation.id: Ia ingin membantu biaya perjalanan.

rounds.prompt: Where will she meet the others?
options: At the pickup point at one.
At the place serving lunch.
At her home while cooking.
At the garage after everyone eats.

cue.en: Listen for the destination after her errands.
cue.id: Dengarkan tujuan setelah urusannya selesai.

explanation.en: She will travel directly to the restaurant.
explanation.id: Ia akan langsung menuju restoran.

rounds.prompt: What is her likely next step?
options: Find a completely new physician.
Request a change to the treatment.
Move the appointment to another day.
Stop every treatment without asking.

cue.en: Listen for the reason she plans to return.
cue.id: Dengarkan alasan ia berencana kembali.

explanation.en: The current medicine is not helping, so she wants it changed.
explanation.id: Obat saat ini tidak membantu, sehingga ia ingin menggantinya.

rounds.prompt: What happens when more catalogs arrive?
options: One will be sent to her address.
He will search his bag for a spare.
He will read all the product details aloud.
She must visit immediately to collect one.

cue.en: Connect the requested address with later delivery.
cue.id: Hubungkan alamat yang diminta dengan pengiriman nanti.

explanation.en: He offers to send a catalog when stock arrives.
explanation.id: Ia menawarkan pengiriman katalog ketika stok tersedia.

rounds.prompt: How does she feel about Lisa’s pottery?
options: She hopes to purchase all of it.
She believes Lisa needs more helpers.
She has never looked at the pieces.
She thinks Lisa has surpassed her usual work.

cue.en: Listen for the evaluative meaning of outdid herself.
cue.id: Dengarkan makna penilaian dalam outdid herself.

explanation.en: She is praising Lisa’s achievement.
explanation.id: Ia memuji hasil karya Lisa.

rounds.prompt: What does his reply suggest about the music?
options: He had not noticed its effect on her reading.
He believes reading never needs quiet.
He could not hear her request.
He wants her to switch off her own equipment.

cue.en: Listen to how his question responds to new information.
cue.id: Dengarkan bagaimana pertanyaannya menanggapi informasi baru.

explanation.en: He seems unaware that the stereo was disturbing her.
explanation.id: Ia tampaknya tidak menyadari bahwa stereo mengganggunya.

rounds.prompt: How does he react to the lab workload?
options: He plans to avoid today’s laboratory.
He blames the woman for complaining.
He shares her concern about the tight deadline.
He believes there is plenty of time.

cue.en: Listen for the agreement before the time-pressure comment.
cue.id: Dengarkan persetujuan sebelum komentar tentang waktu.

explanation.en: He agrees that completing the report will be difficult in time.
explanation.id: Ia setuju laporan sulit diselesaikan tepat waktu.

rounds.prompt: What has changed about her view of the sculptures?
options: She has stopped trying to understand art.
She dislikes them more than before.
She now enjoys what she initially disliked.
She has always shared his negative view.

cue.en: Compare at first with now.
cue.id: Bandingkan at first dengan now.

explanation.en: Her initial dislike has become appreciation.
explanation.id: Ketidaksukaan awal berubah menjadi apresiasi.

rounds.prompt: What possibility does he suggest for improving Italian?
options: Choose any option immediately.
Practice only with him at home.
Explore an offering at the community college.
Teach a new course herself.

cue.en: Hear the question as a suggestion to investigate an option.
cue.id: Dengarkan pertanyaan sebagai saran untuk mencari pilihan.

explanation.en: He suggests looking into a college offering.
explanation.id: Ia menyarankan mencari program di perguruan tinggi setempat.

rounds.prompt: What does she say about her last haircut?
options: She goes every few days.
It happened more than a month ago.
It was meant as a joke.
The stylist has been away all month.

cue.en: Attend to the time interval in her correction.
cue.id: Perhatikan rentang waktu dalam koreksinya.

explanation.en: She disputes that her previous visit was recent.
explanation.id: Ia menyangkal bahwa kunjungan sebelumnya baru saja terjadi.

rounds.prompt: What adjustment might improve the photographs?
options: Use film suited to indoor conditions.
Replace the whole camera immediately.
Photograph only outside from now on.
Avoid including faces in photographs.

cue.en: Listen for the contrast between outdoor and indoor film.
cue.id: Dengarkan perbedaan film luar dan dalam ruangan.

explanation.en: The film may have been unsuitable for the indoor setting.
explanation.id: Film mungkin tidak cocok untuk kondisi dalam ruangan.

rounds.prompt: What does his response suggest about the dessert?
options: It has not arrived yet.
He wants to invite John out.
It will be as remarkable as the sandwiches.
He prepared it for John.

cue.en: Hear wait until you see as a positive anticipation cue.
cue.id: Dengarkan wait until you see sebagai petunjuk antisipasi positif.

explanation.en: He expects the dessert to impress her too.
explanation.id: Ia memperkirakan hidangan penutup juga akan mengesankannya.

rounds.prompt: What arrangement did she make for the collection?
options: Notify the library of needed items beforehand.
Apply to work in the collection.
Speak personally to the director.
Arrive before the doors opened.

cue.en: Listen for the advance-notice requirement.
cue.id: Dengarkan persyaratan pemberitahuan sebelumnya.

explanation.en: She requested the materials a day before using them.
explanation.id: Ia meminta bahan sehari sebelum menggunakannya.

rounds.prompt: What role will calculators have in the course?
options: The lecturer will give one to everyone.
They will help with the statistics work.
They will be prohibited for calculations.
They will replace a prerequisite course.

cue.en: Connect come in handy with a practical use.
cue.id: Hubungkan come in handy dengan kegunaan praktis.

explanation.en: Calculators should be useful for the statistical work.
explanation.id: Kalkulator akan berguna untuk pekerjaan statistik.

rounds.prompt: Where does she suggest looking for George?
options: In his bedroom after a late night.
In the laboratory where he spends much time.
Beside the work she needs to mark.
Nowhere; she offers no possible location.

cue.en: Interpret the exaggeration about sleeping there.
cue.id: Tafsirkan ungkapan berlebihan tentang tidur di sana.

explanation.en: She associates George strongly with the laboratory.
explanation.id: Ia mengaitkan George dengan laboratorium.

rounds.prompt: What prevented her from buying the coat?
options: She could not find a suitable size.
She disliked how well it fitted.
She believed the price was excessive.
She was waiting for a discounted price.

cue.en: Listen for the unreal condition about size.
cue.id: Dengarkan kondisi yang tidak terpenuhi tentang ukuran.

explanation.en: She would have bought it if her size had been available.
explanation.id: Ia akan membelinya jika ukurannya tersedia.

rounds.prompt: What is his plan for the warmer weekend?
options: Repair part of his own house.
Turn up the heat inside his home.
Cancel all work because time is short.
Visit his spouse’s mother instead.

cue.en: Keep the two speakers’ plans separate.
cue.id: Pisahkan rencana kedua pembicara.

explanation.en: He plans to repair loose shutters at home.
explanation.id: Ia berencana memperbaiki daun jendela yang longgar di rumah.

rounds.prompt: How likely is it that Jan will change her plan?
options: Very likely if a friend suggests traveling.
Unlikely once she is determined.
Likely after meeting new classmates.
She has no interest in going overseas.

cue.en: Use lost cause and determination together.
cue.id: Hubungkan lost cause dengan tekadnya.

explanation.en: The woman thinks persuading Jan will not work.
explanation.id: Perempuan itu menganggap membujuk Jan tidak akan berhasil.

rounds.prompt: Why does she mention the film’s awards?
options: To express disbelief about every award.
To say no interesting films are available.
To recommend watching an awards broadcast.
To give a reason to reconsider seeing the film.

cue.en: Hear but as a challenge to the first speaker’s lack of interest.
cue.id: Dengarkan but sebagai tanggapan terhadap kurangnya minat pembicara pertama.

explanation.en: The awards are offered as a reason to give the film a chance.
explanation.id: Penghargaan diberikan sebagai alasan untuk mencoba menonton film tersebut.

rounds.prompt: Why is resting difficult for him?
options: He has been waiting too long for treatment.
He believes help is unnecessary.
He cannot tolerate any pain when walking.
He dislikes repeatedly relying on his friends.

cue.en: Listen for the emotional difficulty rather than inventing a medical reason.
cue.id: Dengarkan kesulitan emosional tanpa menambahkan alasan medis.

explanation.en: Depending on friends makes him uncomfortable.
explanation.id: Bergantung pada teman membuatnya tidak nyaman.

rounds.prompt: What does she remind him to retrieve?
options: Her paper that she took earlier.
A case placed on a newspaper.
An article he intended to show her.
A completely different forgotten object.

cue.en: Connect the forgotten purpose with her reminder.
cue.id: Hubungkan tujuan yang terlupa dengan pengingatnya.

explanation.en: He came for a newspaper article in his briefcase.
explanation.id: Ia datang mengambil artikel koran dalam tas kerjanya.

rounds.prompt: What is her concern about the old washer?
options: It has never worked at all.
It is impossible for a machine to last that long.
Replacement parts may be unavailable.
Every part has already been replaced.

cue.en: Listen for the practical obstacle to repairing an old model.
cue.id: Dengarkan hambatan praktis dalam memperbaiki model lama.

explanation.en: Its age makes obtaining repair parts doubtful.
explanation.id: Usianya membuat ketersediaan suku cadang diragukan.

rounds.prompt: Why did he need the professor’s signature?
options: To enroll despite lacking the introductory course.
To challenge the mark on his project.
To locate a basic class for beginners.
To ask for extra project time.

cue.en: Notice no rejecting the guessed reason, then the real purpose.
cue.id: Perhatikan no yang menolak dugaan, lalu tujuan sebenarnya.

explanation.en: He needs authorization to enter an advanced seminar.
explanation.id: Ia memerlukan izin mengikuti seminar tingkat lanjut.

rounds.prompt: What is she doing before signing?
options: Checking spelling in a report.
Asking a question she cannot explain.
Taking another look at the agreement.
Declining an argument with the speaker.

cue.en: Listen for the action she wants before signing.
cue.id: Dengarkan tindakan yang ia inginkan sebelum menandatangani.

explanation.en: She wants to read the agreement again before committing.
explanation.id: Ia ingin membaca perjanjian sekali lagi sebelum menyetujuinya.
